messages:
olivia: quick follow-up from today’s all-hands security segment. customers asked for a concise timeline for SOC2/ISO evidence delivery, KMS BYOK in EU, and the VPC private control plane.

tara (Security): short answers: evidence pack + compliance UI is the immediate priority; BYOK (key import) is next, starting in EU; private control plane follows. i’ll post a compact timeline in the all-hands follow-up.

samir: other ask: can audit logs be exported per-org to S3 or syslog, and can retention be set per-customer?

dev-platform: yes. building export connectors: daily S3 snapshot, syslog/webhook streaming, and managed archive. retention configurable per-org via console/API. beta next month. example CLI: `redwood audit export --org=acme --dest=s3://acme-logs --from=2026-04-01 --to=2026-04-30`.

maria: will exports redact PII by default? auditors sometimes need unredacted bundles.

tara (Security): default exports are PII-redacted. we provide an audited unredacted bundle workflow for auditors (NDA + approvals + access logs).

olivia: any ETA numbers we can quote for RFPs?

tara (Security): targets (tentative): evidence pack + UI improvements: end of Q2 (June); KMS BYOK EU import beta: late Q3 (Aug); cross-account KMS/HSM integrations & rotation APIs: Q4; VPC private control plane GA: Q4. audit-export beta: early next month (May).

samir: for BYOK, what about rotation and emergency revoke?

tara (Security): two modes: managed keys (we can auto-rotate) and imported keys (customer controls rotation). we provide rotation APIs, CLI support, and emergency revoke workflows with audit trails.

maria: can someone create a short customer one-pager and FAQ comparing SOC2 vs ISO scope and what evidence we provide? sales need it by next Friday.

compliance-bot: @maria created COMP-601: "SOC2/ISO one-pager + BYOK & VPC FAQ" assigned to @maria, due 2026-05-08.

maria: will draft and post to #docs by EOD Friday.

dev-platform: if you want early access to the audit export beta DM me your org id and we’ll enable the toggle.

olivia: thanks all. tara please drop the bullets into the follow-up doc so i can include in the summary email.

tara (Security): will do in ~30m and tag leadership. :+1:
